title: The House
logline: A daughter tries to understand the truth after finding the family deed missing.

scenes.heading: INT. FAMILY KITCHEN - NIGHT
scenes.dramatic_event: the daughter notices the missing deed and tests her father without revealing what she knows
scenes.entry_state_summary: Father sits at the table; daughter enters with an empty document folder.
action: The daughter places the empty folder on the table.
The father continues folding a hospital receipt instead of meeting her eyes.

dialogue.speaker: C01
dialogue.text: Did you move the house papers?
dialogue.subtext: Tell me the truth without making me accuse you.

dialogue.speaker: C02
dialogue.subtext: I cannot tell you what I sold yet.

scenes.exit_state_summary: The daughter now suspects the papers are gone; the father still hides the reason.
